core_meaning.primary_meaning: Feroze is a Persian-origin name meaning “Victorious”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Feroze corresponds to the Persian form فيروز (Persian فیروز (Fīrūz) < Middle Persian pērōz 'victorious'). Its core sense is turquoise. Feroze is a common South Asian spelling of the Persian name فیروز (Fīrūz), 'victorious', also the source of the word for the turquoise gem. The source labelled it 'Arabic' and glossed it 'victorious, brave'; 'victorious' is defensible, 'brave' is a loose association.
